topic: Venue funding spreads and DIY carry on Hyperliquid

funding_snapshot_2026_10_16.source: exchange APIs (hyperliquid /info, binance fapi, okx v5, bybit v5)
funding_snapshot_2026_10_16.notes: Funding is volatile hour-to-hour; use 30-90d means for decisions. HL median sits exactly at the 10.95% APR interest-component plateau (47-52% of hours).

cex_vs_cex.verdict: not persistent - within noise after 4-leg costs; only HL vs all-CEX spread is structural

why_hyperliquid_higher: identical formula but interest plateau: premium in [-0.04%, +0.06%] pins funding at exactly 10.95% APR; HL perp trades at/above oracle most hours (long-biased flow)
leverage-hungry user base (up to 40x) skews long
constrained cross-venue arbitrage capital: thinner HL spot book, legging risk, USDC on-chain friction keeps premium from being arb'd away
hourly settlement and 4%/hour cap let imbalance express more aggressively (Talos: HL funding 1.95x more volatile than Binance)

diy_carry.structure: spot BTC on Binance + USDC-margined short perp on Hyperliquid, delta ~ 0

edge_vs_sUSDe_pp.comment: 0.2-1.5pp depending on funding scenario; instant 11% would give up to +3.1pp but is not a run-rate

diy_carry.liquidation_economics: delta-neutral structure makes short liquidation economically near-neutral (spot gain offsets short loss; residual maintenance ~1.25% notional burns); real costs = delta gap before re-short, re-entry timing, margin top-up ops

custody_validators.june_2026_bank_run: 58% of outflow was one wallet; withdrawals processed

incidents.event: North Korea-linked probing; ~$250M outflows in a day, HYPE -21%
JELLY exploit vs HLP (~$12M); forced delist/settlement by validator vote; memecoin leverage capped
cascade: 60,650+ traders liquidated, ~$1.25B liquidations, $7.4B+ OI destroyed; cross-margin ADL closed $2.1B in 12 min incl. profitable shorts
bridge bank-run stress; processed without halt

hyperliquid_risks.adl_risk_for_carry: profitable short force-closed at bankruptcy price in cascades; funding collapses post-cascade (income stops exactly when it matters)
hyperliquid_risks.oracle: validators compute weighted median of CEX spot prices; low risk for BTC/ETH, elevated for memecoins (JELLY)
hyperliquid_risks.regulatory: US geofenced; EU gray zone (no MiCA); CFTC onshoring push Aug-2026 (Kraken/Payward via Bitnomial); CFTC ANPRM 2026-10-05

allocation_advice.principle: post-Bitget ($387.5M, Sept-2026): any exchange balance = unsecured lending to the exchange
rules: HL short leg leverage <= 2-3x with 15-25% USDC buffer
exit when 30d spread < +2pp; flat when 7d spread negative
never both legs on one venue
capacity fine up to ~$5-10M per account (BTC OI $3.4B, daily volume $2.45B)

verdict.spread_nature: structural (interest plateau 10.95% + long-biased leveraged user base + constrained arb capital), not a one-candle artifact like OKX/Bybit snapshots
verdict.spread_persistence: 12m avg +2.5-3.1pp BTC; positive 77% (BTC) / 87% (ETH) of days; compresses to ~0 in risk-off quarters; one monthly inversion (ETH Feb-2026 -3.3pp)
verdict.diy_carry_net: 4.0-6.4% APR on capital after costs (12m/30d funding scenarios); premium over sUSDe +0.2-1.5pp
verdict.worth_it: yes, as small automated sleeve (5-10% of alpha budget) with strict exit rules - not as an sUSDe replacement at 11%
verdict.hl_pools: HLP ok (2-3%, volatile); growihf = anonymous quant fund, short-vol, no audit - venture only 1-2%; Katana unverifiable
